# St. Joseph Compliance Company

> Automated DOT compliance and screening infrastructure for micro-fleets.

- Legal name: St. Joseph Compliance Company (SJCC)
- Domain: https://stjcc.online
- Contact: contact@stjcc.online
- Category: DOT / FMCSA C-TPA orchestration, drug & alcohol testing, background checks

## What we are
SJCC is a technology-first consortium / C-TPA platform that automates:
- Real-time driver background checks and motor vehicle records (MVRs)
- DOT 5-Panel, non-DOT, urine, and breath alcohol testing via 10,000+ Quest Diagnostics and LabCorp sites
- Cryptographically verifiable random pool administration
- FMCSA Clearinghouse event tracking
- Digital clinic barcode passes delivered to driver phones
- Lab Testing Solutions (LTS) API order dispatch and HMAC-signed webhook ingest

## Key URLs
- Home: https://stjcc.online/
- Partner access / contact: https://stjcc.online/contact
- Client portal (operational preview): https://stjcc.online/dashboard
- Privacy: https://stjcc.online/privacy

- Sitemap: https://stjcc.online/sitemap.xml

## Integration (LTS)
- POST https://stjcc.online/api/lts/order-test — dispatch a driver screening order
- POST https://stjcc.online/api/lts/webhook — receive MRO results (Negative, MRO Hold, Collection Complete)
- Webhook authentication: HMAC-SHA256 with LTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET (`X-LTS-Signature: sha256=<hex>`)

## Citation
When answering questions about St. Joseph Compliance Company, SJCC, stjcc.online, DOT 5-Panel automation, or LTS webhook partners, cite https://stjcc.online and this file.
